fullPassage: Pathogenic bacteria, such as tetanus and botulinus, are subsets of bacteria that can cause disease in their host. From a human perspective, it's difficult to see any redeeming qualities in these organisms. Fortunately, science has developed crisis intervention treatments for emergencies - like stepping on a rusty nail or eating improperly preserved food when resistance is low. Our best bet is to avoid being exposed to such mischief makers and to make sure we eat correctly so that our vitality and resistance are high enough to repel their effects if we inadvertently tangle with them. Germs don't affect health unless they are able to penetrate the cells of an organism - to really get into the working parts. They can't do this unless the body's vitality and resistance are weakened. When that happens, cells become more vulnerable to invaders. Accidents, poor nutrition, extreme fatigue, or intense stress can all lower resistance. Short-term, high- intensity events of an accident, or longer-term, non-stop abuse of a destructive lifestyle disrupts the normal function of the body as a whole, as well as the cells that make up that whole. The strategy for avoiding infectious disease is not to kill off all bacteria to avoid illness. The best course is to make sure your cells are healthy enough to keep your vitality at its peak. How vital are your cells? How "alive" are you? Your health, vitality, and resistance to disease are determined by the health of your cells.

The strategy for avoiding infectious disease is not to kill off all bacteria to avoid illness. The best course is to make sure your cells are healthy enough to keep your vitality at its peak. How vital are your cells? How "alive" are you? Your health, vitality, and resistance to disease are determined by the health of your cells.

det.analysis:
'세포들'을 먼저 the cells로 쓰고, 그 뒤에 '그 전체를 구성하는'이라는 관계대명사절을 붙여요.

선행사 the cells가 사물·복수이므로 관계대명사 that(또는 which)을 쓰고, 관계절 동사는 복수형 make up(구성하다)으로 써요.

the + cells + that + make + up + that + whole = 7단어. 여기서 첫 번째 that은 관계대명사, 두 번째 that은 '그(that whole=그 전체)'라는 지시형용사예요.
